> Please open this issue **before** submitting large audio files, so we can confirm
> format and labeling. See `Docs/contributing_recordings.md` for the full process.

## What did you record?

- **Type:** Speaker IR / Mic IR / Room tone / Preset
- **Name / description:** (e.g. "1970s intercom speaker", "ribbon mic", "concrete stairwell tone")
- **How many files:**

## Equipment Used

- **Reproducer / mic / space:**
- **Capture chain:** (mic(s), interface, preamp, etc.)
- **Method:** (e.g. exponential sine sweep + deconvolution, ambient capture)

## Recording Conditions

Location, noise floor, anything notable about the capture.

## Format

- [ ] 48 kHz
- [ ] 24-bit WAV
- [ ] Trimmed / DC-offset removed
- [ ] Looping cleanly (room tones)

## License Assignment

- [ ] I have the right to license these recordings, and I agree they will be
      distributed under the project's **GPL-3.0** license as part of Worldizer.

## Attachment Instructions

Do not attach large files to this issue. Link to a download (or note that you'll
open a PR adding them to the appropriate `Resources/` subfolder with a metadata sidecar).
